svg.text: Sales reason applies to online orders only — selecting one excludes all 3,806 reseller orders (73.4% of gross sales)
Online channel only — resellers never record a sales reason
Every widget on this page is filtered to online orders (27,659 orders · $29.4M gross). All 3,806 reseller orders are structurally incapable of carrying a sales reason.
Promotions are recorded only on bike orders — never on an accessory-only basket
Which is why promotion performance must be judged against other bike orders, not against all orders
Price is the leading declared reason; three marketing channels have never produced an order
Online orders citing each sales reason
Slate bars are absences, not reasons. An order can cite up to 3 reasons, so this column cannot be totalled.
Controlled for product mix, promotion orders are worth 5% LESS than comparable bike orders
Average order value of online orders · bike orders isolated
Against ALL other online orders this would read +90% — that is bikes vs. bottles, not the promotion.
No online order line carries a discount: the ‘On Promotion’ reason is not linked to any recorded price benefit, so promotion ROI cannot be measured today.
